recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a white t-shirt looking over his shoulder, set against a blurred rural landscape, featuring large, stylized slab-serif typography with a landscape-texture fill.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at viewer creates intimate connection
Text overlay interacts with the subject's torso through layering
Warm golden light on the face balances the cool green background
Heavy slab-serif font anchors the airy, soft-focus environment
coreInvariants: Blurred natural background with horizontal horizon line
High-key lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large-scale typography on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the arm to the tattoo, then across to the large text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred green space on the left side provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and browns in the background provide a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the t-shirt and the highlights in the text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and warm skin tones provide a sun-kissed glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky and shirt; medium saturation in the grass; high contrast between text and background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight vertical emphasis
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are connected by horizontal bars or frames
Text contains a masked image of a sunlit field

composition.overlap: Partially overlaps the subject's white shirt

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scale and masking effects.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and traditional slab serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution portrait of a young man with short dark hair and a white t-shirt, looking over his shoulder at the camera. The background should be a soft-focus, sun-drenched green field at golden hour.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked uppercase text in a heavy slab-serif font on the left side. Mask the text with a bright, sunlit landscape image and add a thin white outline and horizontal framing bars.

verificationChecks: Is the text masked with a landscape texture?
Does the subject's gaze meet the camera?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?
Are the slab serifs prominent and blocky?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Verify the over-the-shoulder pose is maintained
Confirm the golden hour lighting effect
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Blurred Rural Background + Masked Slab-Serif Typography = Modern Country Aesthetic
